diff --git a/llvm/docs/CommandGuide/llvm-profgen.rst b/llvm/docs/CommandGuide/llvm-profgen.rst
index e28841f9927c..78ade5c0a4a6 100644
--- a/llvm/docs/CommandGuide/llvm-profgen.rst
+++ b/llvm/docs/CommandGuide/llvm-profgen.rst
@@ -1191,6 +1191,27 @@ Field paths
 ``samples.target.in_func_no_line`` (object | string)
   In a function but without a usable leaf source position.
 
+``samples.target.in_func_no_line.nonleaf_line_zero`` (object | string)
+    Subset of in_func_no_line excluded because a positive leaf line has a
+    non-leaf frame with raw line zero. The entire inline context is excluded;
+    no callsite is synthesized by subtracting its start line. Unknown before
+    classification. This IP-only subset does not change LBR handling.
+
+``samples.target.in_func_no_line.nonleaf_line_zero.sample_count`` (uint64)
+    Number of excluded original IP samples; unit: samples.
+
+``samples.target.in_func_no_line.nonleaf_line_zero.period_sum`` (uint64)
+    Sum of their periods; unit: event counts.
+
+``samples.target.in_func_no_line.nonleaf_line_zero.normalized_weight`` (object)
+    Exact weight ratio, with the same semantics as the parent count object.
+
+``samples.target.in_func_no_line.nonleaf_line_zero.normalized_weight.numerator`` (uint64)
+    Sample count in sample mode, or period sum in period mode.
+
+``samples.target.in_func_no_line.nonleaf_line_zero.normalized_weight.denominator`` (uint64)
+    One in sample mode, or P_ref in period mode.
+
 ``samples.target.in_func_no_line.normalized_weight`` (object)
   Exact selected raw weight divided by P_ref; unknown until P_ref is known.
 
diff --git a/llvm/test/tools/llvm-profgen/ip-nonleaf-zero.test b/llvm/test/tools/llvm-profgen/ip-nonleaf-zero.test

-#===- ip-nonleaf-zero.test - Diagnose zero non-leaf lines -----------------===#
+#===- ip-nonleaf-zero.test - Reject missing IP callsite lines --------------===#
 # REQUIRES: aarch64-registered-target
 # RUN: split-file %s %t

-# Count each usable sample once: 2 samples, 3+7=10 periods; top-only sample
-# remains usable and does not contribute to the diagnostic subset.
-# RUN: llvm-profgen --ip-samples --allow-missing-build-id --binary=%S/Inputs/ip-mode/counting-extra/nonleaf-zero.perfbin --binary-match-regex=^/target$ --perfscript=%t/input --format=text --output=%t/profile --ip-aggregation=sum --ip-period-unit=1 --show-ip-address-counts > %t/log
+# Two positive leaf lines have raw caller line zero. Exclude both whole
+# contexts, leaving only the top-level sample (100 periods), not a partial tree.
+# RUN: llvm-profgen --ip-samples --allow-missing-build-id --binary=%S/Inputs/ip-mode/counting-extra/nonleaf-zero.perfbin --binary-match-regex=^/target$ --perfscript=%t/input --format=text --output=%t/profile --quality-report=%t/report.json --ip-aggregation=sum --ip-period-unit=1 --show-ip-address-counts > %t/log
 # RUN: FileCheck %s --check-prefix=ZERO --input-file=%t/log

-# ZERO-NEXT: IP-GENERATION usable_nonleaf_line_zero samples=2 period_sum=10
+# ZERO-DAG: IP-GENERATION in_func_no_line samples=2 period_sum=10
+# ZERO-DAG: IP-GENERATION nonleaf_line_zero samples=2 period_sum=10
+# ZERO-DAG: IP-GENERATION usable samples=1 period_sum=100
+# ZERO-DAG: IP-GENERATION usable_nonleaf_line_zero samples=0 period_sum=0
 # RUN: FileCheck %s --check-prefix=TOTAL --input-file=%t/profile
-# TOTAL: both:110:0
-# Unmodified fixture is a negative control; the extra diagnostic must not
-# classify the usual positive caller line as zero just because offsets differ.
-# RUN: llvm-profgen --ip-samples --allow-missing-build-id --binary=%S/Inputs/ip-mode/counting-extra/head.perfbin --binary-match-regex=^/target$ --perfscript=%t/input --format=text --output=%t/control --ip-aggregation=sum --ip-period-unit=1 --show-ip-address-counts > %t/control.log
+# TOTAL: both:100:0
+# TOTAL-NEXT:  2: 100
+# TOTAL-NOT: 65525
+# TOTAL-NOT: left
+# TOTAL-NOT: right
+# RUN: %python %t/check.py %t/report.json %t/profile
+# Max must apply the same exclusion and keep the unaffected top-only count.
+# RUN: llvm-profgen --ip-samples --allow-missing-build-id --binary=%S/Inputs/ip-mode/counting-extra/nonleaf-zero.perfbin --binary-match-regex=^/target$ --perfscript=%t/input --format=text --output=%t/max --quality-report=%t/max.json --ip-aggregation=max --ip-period-unit=1
+# RUN: %python %t/check.py %t/max.json %t/max
+# Unmodified fixture retains positive callsite lines and the complete tree.
+# RUN: llvm-profgen --ip-samples --allow-missing-build-id --binary=%S/Inputs/ip-mode/counting-extra/head.perfbin --binary-match-regex=^/target$ --perfscript=%t/input --format=text --output=%t/control --quality-report=%t/control.json --ip-aggregation=sum --ip-period-unit=1 --show-ip-address-counts > %t/control.log
 # RUN: FileCheck %s --check-prefix=CONTROL --input-file=%t/control.log
-# CONTROL: IP-GENERATION usable samples=3 period_sum=110
-# CONTROL-NEXT: IP-GENERATION usable_nonleaf_line_zero samples=0 period_sum=0
-# RUN: FileCheck %s --check-prefix=TOTAL --input-file=%t/control
+# CONTROL-DAG: IP-GENERATION in_func_no_line samples=0 period_sum=0
+# CONTROL-DAG: IP-GENERATION nonleaf_line_zero samples=0 period_sum=0
+# CONTROL-DAG: IP-GENERATION usable samples=3 period_sum=110
+# RUN: FileCheck %s --check-prefix=CONTROL-PROFILE --input-file=%t/control
+# CONTROL-PROFILE: both:110:0
+# CONTROL-PROFILE: 1: {{.*}}left
+# CONTROL-PROFILE: 1: {{.*}}right
+# All samples excluded: fail generation and preserve an existing profile.
+# RUN: echo old-profile > %t/old
+# RUN: not llvm-profgen --ip-samples --allow-missing-build-id --binary=%S/Inputs/ip-mode/counting-extra/nonleaf-zero.perfbin --binary-match-regex=^/target$ --perfscript=%t/zero-only --format=text --output=%t/old --quality-report=%t/failed.json --ip-aggregation=sum --ip-period-unit=1 2>&1 | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=FAIL
+# FAIL: no usable samples
+# RUN: %python %t/failure.py %t/failed.json %t/old
 #--- input
 17/17 3 cycles: 12f0 (/target+0x2f0)
 17/17 7 cycles: 12d8 (/target+0x2d8)
 17/17 100 cycles: 1300 (/target+0x300)
+#--- zero-only
+17/17 3 cycles: 12f0 (/target+0x2f0)
+17/17 7 cycles: 12d8 (/target+0x2d8)
+#--- check.py
+import json, pathlib, sys
+r = json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
+t = r['samples']['target']
+assert t['in_func_no_line']['sample_count'] == 2
+assert t['in_func_no_line']['period_sum'] == 10
+assert t['in_func_no_line']['nonleaf_line_zero']['sample_count'] == 2
+assert t['in_func_no_line']['nonleaf_line_zero']['period_sum'] == 10
+assert t['usable']['sample_count'] == 1
+assert pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text() == 'both:100:0\n 2: 100\n'
+#--- failure.py
+import json, pathlib, sys
+r = json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
+assert r['verdict']['conversion'] == 'failed'
+assert r['verdict']['failure_stage'] == 'generate'
+assert r['samples']['target']['in_func_no_line']['nonleaf_line_zero']['sample_count'] == 2
+assert pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text() == 'old-profile\n'
